actions: Secondary click target Empty header area using XTest.
Capture whole compositor including Mutter popup.
Dismiss with XTest Escape.
Secondary click target Minimize window using XTest.
Secondary click target Overview tab using XTest.
Maximize target Maximize for menu state check using XTest.
Secondary click target Empty header area using XTest.
Capture whole compositor including Mutter popup.

assertions.requirement: A real secondary-click on empty GNOME header space opens the Mutter window menu.
assertions.expected: A visible native compositor window menu is present after the original GDK button event.

assertions.requirement: The GNOME window menu opens at the pointer.
assertions.expected: The captured pointer coordinate lies within the native popup bounds, with the CSS-to-GDK and desktop-to-popup mapping recorded.

assertions.requirement: The restored-window menu model exposes the required GNOME system menu actions.
assertions.expected: Minimize, Maximize, Move, Resize, Always on Top, Always on Visible Workspace, and Close are represented.

assertions.requirement: The maximized-window menu model exposes Restore instead of Maximize.
assertions.expected: Restore is present and Maximize is absent after the test window is maximized.

assertions.requirement: A secondary-click on a window control does not open the compositor window menu.
assertions.expected: No Mutter window menu appears after the control secondary-click.

assertions.requirement: A secondary-click on a tab does not open the compositor window menu.
assertions.expected: No Mutter window menu appears after the tab secondary-click.

actions: Click target Select kit fallback mode using runner virtual input/libei.
Secondary click target Empty header area using runner virtual input/libei.
Capture whole compositor including kit fallback.

assertions.requirement: The kit fallback menu appears at the pointer when selected.
assertions.expected: The app's accessible kit menu is visible and its bounds contain the pointer coordinate.

assertions.requirement: The kit fallback presents the same seven GNOME menu items.
assertions.expected: Minimize, Maximize, Move, Resize, Always on Top, Always on Visible Workspace, and Close are represented.

assertions.requirement: The kit fallback marks unsupported Resize honestly.
assertions.expected: Resize is visible, disabled, and accompanied by an explicit test-shell limitation.
